name: Southland Steel Fabricators, Inc.
old_description: Founded in 1986, Southland Steel Fabricators is owned and operated by the Lombardo family. Built upon the philosophy of hard work and ethical business practices, our company has grown immensely over the years and is now one of the largest steel fabricators in the region.
about:
Southland Steel Fabricators, Inc. was founded in 1986 in Greensburg, Louisiana. The company is owned and operated by the Lombardo family, built on a philosophy of hard work and ethical business practices. It has grown to become one of the largest steel fabricators in the region.

The firm provides a full spectrum of steel fabrication services, including 3D modeling (using SDS/2), engineering, structural and miscellaneous steel fabrication, in-house detailing, project management, and quality assurance. Its 300,000-square-foot fabrication facility houses CNC technology, while a separate 20,000-square-foot coating plant handles fireproofing, galvanizing, and complex industrial coatings. A workforce of more than 200 professionals supports high-volume production capabilities.

Southland Steel serves customers in the steel fabrication industry, with projects ranging from 1,000 to 24,000 tons and values up to $120 million. Its centralized location near Interstates 10 and 12 and the ports of New Orleans and Baton Rouge enables efficient shipping to regional and national clients.

The company emphasizes competitive pricing, innovative scheduling, and personalized service stemming from family ownership, aiming to deliver projects on time, on budget, and to the highest quality standards.
type_evidence: Southland Steel delivers a full spectrum of quality products and services related to the steel fabrication industry.
